# WalkMe

> WalkMe is a digital adoption platform providing enterprise software guidance and security solutions with comprehensive compliance and data protection standards.

WalkMe focuses on security, compliance, and data protection across its platform, adhering to international standards including GDPR, FISMA, and NIST frameworks. The platform emphasizes data residency, encryption, and access control to meet enterprise security requirements.

## Key Topics

- WalkMe Platform
- GDPR Compliance
- FISMA
- NIST Standards
- Data Protection
- Encryption
- Access Control
- Standard Contractual Clauses
- Data Processing Addendum
- Subresource Integrity
- CISA
- Data Residency
- Security Compliance

## Security & Compliance

- [WalkMe Security](https://www.walkme.com/walkme-security): WalkMe platform security, compliance standards (FISMA, GDPR), and data protection
